Video.summary: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

Video.summary: Experience the high-stakes intensity of the 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championship as the top-seeded FAU Owls face off against the underdog TCU Horned Frogs in a fight for a spot in the finals. This match delivers pure "Racing" energy, defined by relentless power drives from Bella Nelson and elite hand speed that keeps the pace at a fever pitch. Witness the remarkable "Skills" of Ellie Douglas, who stuns opponents with a rare two-handed slice backhand and masterful "brush strokes" that shift the momentum in favor of the Horned Frogs. The competition reaches a "Freestyle" peak with creative mid-air body blocks and rare "Ernies" on the women's side, capturing the "stone-cold" focus required to pull off a massive tournament upset in women's doubles.
